comment: How the AI advisors decide (GDD 8.1-8.4, 7.6; stages 4a-4b). Every advisor scores its possible actions the same way: a base value times factors from response curves, times the strategist's goal weight and the character multiplier (0.5 + trait), minus the cost. pickAmongTop: how many of the best actions the AI draws among, chances by score (GDD 8.3); a civilization takes the best one outright with a chance equal to its caution. Strategist (every reviewEverySteps own steps of the civilization (ADR 0018), spread over civilizations, and at once in a new era): expansion weight from how full the camps are (up to crowdingLowPercent: expansionWeightMin, at crowdingHighPercent: expansionWeightMax); prosperity and security weight from hunger (fedWellPercent -> 1.0, fedBadlyPercent -> hungerWeightMax); an expansion target on the best known free land, which boosts places closer to it by directionBonusPercent. An expansive civilization splits camps earlier, but never below splitMinPercentOfLevel. Artisans switch recipes only when the new one is better by recipeSwitchBetterByPercent. A hungry or cold camp looks for a better place every searchEverySteps own steps (staggered), every own step when fed below starvingFedPercent or on planets with live seasons.
